active_controls.required: Anchor source statements to original pages/passages; retain all conditions, alternative conjunctions, reception direction, radical/turned-house context, target and temporal resolution. Historical source claims remain distinct from our calculations and outside corroboration.
active_controls.failure: Unsupported paraphrase, silent emendation, wrong frame or stronger outcome claim
active_controls.repair: Reopen source, correct dependents or preserve uncertainty

active_controls.required: Inspect original whole-page images with existing text; disclose actually read pages separately from rendered pages and boundary previews.
active_controls.failure: Glyph guessed from damaged text or rendering counted as reading
active_controls.repair: Inspect original at sufficient resolution; record disagreement

active_controls.required: Historical horary source intake only; no present-person health, safety, financial or political forecasts. No participant-data reads or runtime/model/freeze edits. Supplied memory already includes biographies; no unexposed or blinded claim.
active_controls.failure: Personal fitting, current advice or false independence claim
active_controls.repair: Remove unsupported use and retain source-only meaning

active_controls.required: Reuse existing geometry; compute only explicit reference relationships and static printed-coordinate arithmetic. Keep missing minutes, house interpretation, source timing discretion and calendar/ephemeris parity unresolved where unsupported.
active_controls.failure: Invented thresholds, civil dates or predictive validation
active_controls.repair: Restrict calculation to supported inputs; retain gaps
active_controls.enforcement: Focused meaningful tests and arithmetic reconciliation

active_controls.required: Source reader freezes findings before seeing candidate rationale. Final fresh checker receives report and claim ledger plus minimum authoritative sources, then findings are reconciled.
active_controls.failure: Producer review called independent or key claims unchecked
active_controls.repair: Run bounded separate-context diagnosis and resolve actual findings
